AssistantMessage(content=[TextBlock(text='## Diagnosis\n\nThe Info page (`InfoActivity` → `content_info.xml`) shows a single `TextView` bound to `@string/large_text`. That string held a hand-copied, **truncated** GPL v3: it stopped at\n\n```\n"0. Definitions:"\n"\\"This License\\" refers to version 3 of the GNU General Public License.\\n"\n"..."\n```\n\nso scrolling to the bottom of the Info page showed `...` instead of the license.\n\nThe obvious fix — pasting the full 35 KB license into `large_text` — **does not work**. I verified this with the SDK\'s own `aapt2`: a string resource larger than 32 KB is silently replaced at link time, so the Info page would have rendered the literal placeholder text:\n\n```\nerror: string too large to encode using UTF-8 written instead as \'STRING_TOO_LARGE\'.\nresource 0x7f020005 string/large_text  () "STRING_TOO_LARGE"\n```\n\nThis platform limit is almost certainly why the license was abbreviated in the first place.\n\n## Fix\n\n1. **`app/src/main/res/raw/license_gpl_v3.txt` (new)** — the complete GNU GPL v3 (the project\'s own root `LICENSE`, 674 lines, through `END OF TERMS AND CONDITIONS` and the appendix), stored as a raw resource where no size limit applies.\n2. **`InfoActivity.java`** — loads the raw resource and sets it on the license `TextView`, prefixed with the `License - GPL V 3.0` heading; stream handling is closed in `finally` and falls back to the XML text if reading ever fails.\n3. **`content_info.xml`** — gave the existing `TextView` the id `licenseTextView` (no other layout/behavior change).\n4. **`strings.xml`** — `large_text` is now a short, valid fallback (title, copyright/verbatim notice, link to the full license) instead of a truncated document, plus a new `license_title` string.\n\n## Verification\n\nA full `./gradlew assembleDebug` can\'t run in this environment — the network is closed and AGP 3.1.4 isn\'t in the local Gradle cache, so dependency resolution fails before any compilation (this is environmental, unrelated to the patch). I therefore validated both halves of the build directly with the installed SDK/JDK:\n\n- `aapt2 compile --dir app/src/main/res` → **ALL RESOURCES COMPILE OK**, and `aapt2 link` now emits no `STRING_TOO_LARGE` error; the dump confirms `raw/license_gpl_v3` is packaged and `unzip`-ing it from the APK shows the license ending correctly at `why-not-lgpl.html` with `END OF TERMS AND CONDITIONS` present.\n- `javac` (Temurin 8, `android-28` bootclasspath + the cached support-library jars) compiles `InfoActivity.java` with **no errors**.\n\nResult: opening Menu → Info and scrolling to the end now shows the license in full.')], model='claude-opus-5', parent_tool_use_id=None, error=None, usage={'input_tokens': 2, 'cache_creation_input_tokens': 916, 'cache_read_input_tokens': 50944, 'cache_creation': {'ephemeral_5m_input_tokens': 916, 'ephemeral_1h_input_tokens': 0}, 'output_tokens': 1, 'service_tier': 'standard', 'inference_geo': 'global'}, message_id='msg_011CfYNJNbBjGnrgdYACGp2a', stop_reason=None, session_id='307e66b3-388b-40fd-94c2-a2fa8a50064a', uuid='7dd8d5b3-2aab-4dd0-9686-13fba60d2cf4')
